label: Stuck vacuum alert
info:
When a Valetudo robot reports status "error", ask tudomesh which room it is in and fetch a map image with the robot circled.

Set the TUDOMESH_URL environment variable on this flow (default http://tudomesh:8080), point the MQTT node at your broker, and wire the last node to your notifier (Telegram, Pushover, Home Assistant, ...).
